## LifeVerse Product Discovery

LifeVerse Product Discovery is the official, public, read-only MCP server for the LifeVerse catalog. Agents can list ready-to-use products, search in Chinese or English, inspect one product by slug, and recommend experiences for a natural-language need. The hosted endpoint requires no account or API key and exposes only public catalog data. It does not read account, payment, order, entitlement, review, unpublished-product, or private user data.
